evidence.text: The sound quality is absolutely amazing for this price range.
The ear cups feel cheap and the headband cracked after 2 months.
Battery lasts about 20 hours which is decent.
Bluetooth connection drops every few minutes. Very frustrating.
Best headphones I've owned. Crystal clear calls and great music.

recommendations.title: Address build quality issues
recommendations.description: Upgrade the ear cup and headband materials. Source from a better supplier.

recommendations.title: Fix Bluetooth stability
recommendations.description: Release firmware update to fix Bluetooth 5.0 connection drops.

recommendations.title: Improve packaging presentation
recommendations.description: Add premium unboxing experience to justify price point.

recommendations.title: Respond to negative reviews
recommendations.description: Proactively engage with 1-2 star reviews to offer replacements.
